# Core Labs

> Core Labs builds Sven, an agentic operating system for your business. Sven connects securely to the systems a company already runs on — accounting, ecommerce, CRM, documents, ads — and builds custom software around how that business actually works. It is sold as a subscription, and the platform keeps changing as the business does.
